# Shared memory (cosmo-mem)

The stores are directories of small markdown files in `/cosmoshot/memory` (one git repository).
`cosmo-mem` is the only supported way to read or write them. Never edit the files by hand.
Stores: `program`, `cosmogenitor`, `sonalon`, `plc`, `cyberplanetary`, `platform`.

## Which stores does this session have

    cosmo-mem mount-note --cwd "$PWD"       # the text kept in this repository's AGENTS.md
    cosmo-mem attachments --cwd "$PWD"      # store, read-only|read-write, path on disk

The project is the one whose `cwd_prefixes` (in `/cosmoshot/tools/projects.json`) is the
longest prefix of the directory. Sessions whose project is `program` (the planner, tools,
skills, memory, brand, aiofourown, ecosystem-simulator) have every store read-only. A session
of project P has store P read-write and `program` read-only.

## Read (no identity needed; works on every store)

    cosmo-mem read program _index.md        # the catalogue of a store; start here
    cosmo-mem list plc [--prefix PATH]      # memories with description, size, sha256
    cosmo-mem read plc deploy/k8s-notes.md
    cosmo-mem search plc 'regex'            # exit 1 when nothing matches
    cosmo-mem log plc [PATH] --limit 10     # history with who wrote it and why

Read the catalogue of `program` and of your project's store before you start work.

## Write (only a store marked read-write for you; otherwise exit 4)

    sha=$(cosmo-mem sha plc topic.md)       # a sha256, or the word absent
    cosmo-mem write plc topic.md --if-sha "$sha" --file new.md \
      --cwd "$PWD" --session "$SESSION_ID" --harness claude-code|codex --model "$MODEL" \
      --reason "why" [--task 43]
    cosmo-mem index plc set topic "One sentence saying when to read it." --domain General \
      --cwd "$PWD" --session "$SESSION_ID" --harness claude-code|codex --model "$MODEL" --reason "catalogue it"

- A memory is `STORE/slug.md` with frontmatter `name` (the file stem: lower-case letters,
  digits, hyphens) and a one-line `description`, then the body. Links are `[[slug]]` or
  `[[store:slug]]`. Creating a memory does not touch `_index.md`: run `index set` after it.
- A stale `--if-sha` gives exit 3 and prints the current sha: re-read, merge, retry.
- Content that looks like a credential is refused. Write what the next agent needs, not a log.

## Exit codes

0 ok; 2 usage or validation; 3 stale sha; 4 access denied (read-only store); 5 repository problem.
Full reference: `/cosmoshot/tools/mem/README.md`.
